description: Not a wardrobe so much as a small room that happens to have doors. Two walls of it: mirrored, back-lit, rails on silent runners that bring a section of your life forward when you touch the brass. The air inside is cedar and cold money. The plate is engraved rather than stamped, VALET BY POLARIS, BESPOKE SERIES, and somewhere behind the panelling something quietly maintains a record of everything you have ever chosen to be seen in.
name: Polaris Bespoke Dressing Wall
